items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: Lulu, you know the fella called Lulu. He was a man but they called him Lulu. He featured things like that, he featured like that.

ctx.x: Yeah, but I mean on the piano. Yeah, I played on the piano. And who featured that?

Well people like Sam Henry, that's what I named that, Sam Henry. He featured things like that. I played stuff on the piano. It's what Sam Henry I mentioned, he featured that. The kitchen, Sam Henry. Lulu, you know the fella called Lulu. He was a man but they called him Lulu. He featured things like that, he featured like that. He's a man but I didn't call him Lulu. He was a French fella I think?
